hook: Samy Bengio was born in Paris, France, in 1965 and studied computer science at the Université de Montréal, earning a PhD in 1993 with a thesis on optimizing parametric learning rules for neural networks. He spent the late 1990s and early 2000s at the IDIAP Research Institute and the École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne in Switzerland before joining Google around 2008. At Google he became a leading research manager, helping build the Google Brain team and later leading a large machine learning research group that worked on sequence modeling, speech recognition and adversarial robustness. He left Google in 2021 to become senior director of AI and machine learning research at Apple, and in 2024 also took on an adjunct professorship at EPFL. Bengio has also served in leadership roles for the NeurIPS and ICLR conferences, including as NeurIPS program chair in 2017.
